scope: Independent architecture and security review of baseline and approved delivery changes. This JSON is the only file written by this reviewer.

xssRoomNameSearch.method: Executed the actual search handler in JSDOM with an HTML event-handler payload as a room name.

localStoragePrototypePollution.method: Parsed room configuration containing prototype-related object keys with CampusRoomLayout.parse.

credentialFormatScan.method: Credential-shaped pattern scan of tracked text files. Matching values are never recorded.
limitations: Pattern scans cannot prove absence of every sensitive value.

sourceArchiveScan.method: Inspected ZIP entry names and text without extracting or modifying the archive.

vendoredThreeAdvisories.note: Vendored Three.js is separate from the lockfile dependency. No package was upgraded.

publicResponseHeaders.assessment: Missing policies are defense-in-depth recommendations; this review did not demonstrate an exploit caused by their absence.

htmlRelativeReferences.scope: Static src and href references in baseline public HTML.

nestedLegacyAssets.note: Browser rendering is delegated to the main task; this reviewer did not start a browser.

focusedTests.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/proposal-bridge.test.js src/explorer-url.test.ts tests/delivery-sync.test.ts --maxWorkers=1

fixedFindings.description: Existing HTML-referenced styles and scripts are overwritten during embedded synchronization.
Proposal destination messages use the same room and building resolver as URL entry.
The production nested shell is rebuilt with the current embedded bundle and shared root asset paths.
Alias, URL and public navigation entries reject inherited prototype destinations.

remainingRecommendations.description: Consider tested Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy. Existing inline boot scripts and inline handlers require deliberate migration or allowed hashes before enforcing CSP.

limitations: No active browser penetration test was performed.
No full test suite was run by this reviewer.
Known-advisory and format scans are evidence-bounded and do not establish complete security.
Release deployment and live visual QA remain the responsibility of the main task.
